title: Main branch fails to compile on Rust beta.
body:
## Weekly CI run has failed.
[The offending run.](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/actions/runs/17914563916)

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
the way rust prints lifetimes in type names has seemingly [changed](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/145284/files#diff-1065395e81ed3483eb0f33b94e3f07c6eaaed7f29e11d8e57342da380dda7aa4) and bound lifetimes are now always rendered as `'_`

rust-lang/rust#145284

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: that compiler error is because `bevy_mikktspace` doesn't compile with newer rust versions, so to build bevy 0.16 you need to use a rust version that departed from master around the beginning of May.
